assertions.source: f_3(2) = 0 and c_4(2) = 0 on K_2 (zero 3-/4-body terms in deuteron)

description: Pre-registered 80-dps (50-dps serialized) Option 1B (`qou-3kkz`) evaluation of (1) exact K_A simplex/Hamiltonian-cycle combinatorics, K_4 Tait 12-quark bijection, Wigner SU(4) Majorana space-exchange on [1^A]_{sigma tau} (A <= 4) with A = 5 Pauli shell closure, and symbolic Q(q) 9q/12q colour-reconnection traces & closed plaquette cumulants backing `TetrahedralFluxRingAndMajoranaCluster.lean`; (2A) fixed-radius Hoefsmit S^{[A,A,A]}_{H_{3A}(q_0)} 2-body + 3-body triangular face + 4-body tetrahedral ring models M0..M5; and (2B) zero-parameter 3D Jacobi variational compression models (A - 1 relative kinetic modes vs C(A,2) Wigner pairs) across A = 2, 3, 4.
caveats: 1. Fixing #9221's reversed non-adjacent braid transport in M1_kA_2body_boundary restores exact 1 : 3 : 6 BH2 pair scaling and lifts A=3 at fixed spatial overlap from 5.1059 MeV to 6.9623 MeV (-9.79% vs 3He) while preserving 2H = 2.2648 MeV (+1.81%) and placing pure pairwise 4He at 14.3267 MeV (6.326x, vs single-bag [12]_S12 Pauli-quenched 6.65 MeV). 2. Adding pre-registered positive-braid 3-interface triangular plaquettes across C(A,3) faces and 4-interface Hamiltonian rings across c_4(A) = 3*C(A,4) tetrahedral 4-cycles with direct holonomy sign (+, M3a_kA_plaquette_pos, free_parameters = 0) yields 2H = 2.2648 MeV (+1.81%), A=3 = 9.0140 MeV (+6.27% vs 3H), and 4He = 29.3291 MeV (+3.65% vs 28.2956 MeV, ratio 1 : 3.980 : 12.950 vs empirical 1 : 3.813 : 12.720), while the 2nd-order non-double-counted 3-/4-cluster cumulant sum (M5a) gives 8.5574 MeV (+0.89% vs 3H) and 24.7943 MeV (-12.37% vs 4He); by contrast, the opposite Kogut-Susskind sign (-, M3a_kA_plaquette_neg = 17.5360 MeV) and strictly planar cyclic cumulants without interior braid over-crossings (M5b = 13.5965 MeV) underbind 4He, showing sign/ordering sensitivity of non-local braid holonomies. 3. Independently, pure 2-body Wigner pairing with 3D relative Jacobi variational compression in the order-zero nuclear kinetic scale E_0(q_0) = m_e / (q_0(q_0 - 1)) (J_var_selfbound_E0, free_parameters = 0) brackets empirical 4He between 26.0197 MeV (-8.04%, fixed-eta_2^* Hall-Post bound) and 30.5457 MeV (+7.95%, unrestricted eta_4^*), confirming that 3D Jacobi kinematics and tetrahedral colour-flux ring reconnection must be derived jointly from a single microscopic 3D spatial-braid action so their contributions are not double-counted (as seen in J_var_breath__M3a_plaq_pos = 35.2700 MeV, +24.65%).
